items.markdown:
Sound therapy `uses specific tones, frequencies, and physical vibrations to promote relaxation, mental peace, and stress relief`.[[1]](https://www.uclahealth.org/news/article/what-sound-therapy-and-could-it-benefit-your-health)[[2]](https://www.cedars-sinai.org/stories-and-insights/healthy-living/sound-advice-do-sound-therapy-and-binaural-beats-work)

### Common Types of Sound Therapy

- **Sound baths:** Immersive listening sessions using crystal or metal singing bowls, chimes, and gongs to induce a deeply calm state.[[1]](https://www.cedars-sinai.org/stories-and-insights/healthy-living/sound-advice-do-sound-therapy-and-binaural-beats-work)[[2]](https://www.uclahealth.org/news/article/what-sound-therapy-and-could-it-benefit-your-health)
- **Binaural beats:** Two slightly different sound frequencies played in separate ears through headphones to create a perceived third beat that can aid focus or sleep.[[1]](https://www.uclahealth.org/news/article/what-sound-therapy-and-could-it-benefit-your-health)[[2]](https://www.cedars-sinai.org/stories-and-insights/healthy-living/sound-advice-do-sound-therapy-and-binaural-beats-work)
- **Vibroacoustic therapy:** Low-frequency sound waves delivered through specialized mats or chairs to relax muscles and ease physical discomfort.[[1]](https://aanmc.org/natural-remedies/science-behind-sound-therapy/)[[2]](https://www.uclahealth.org/news/article/what-sound-therapy-and-could-it-benefit-your-health)
- **Everyday sound tools:** White noise machines like the [Yogasleep Dohm Classic](https://www.allegromedical.com/products/products-marpac-dohm-ds-whitenoise-sound-blac-k-color-ea-083-586141-02/?srsltid=AU7gw4Vcnyp9CaaNuOKt2NXbqqaMx-3SHusatn1de633Om3EyAmxHQYLGpA) (~$50) or portable options like the [Homedics Sound Spa](https://shop.tiktok.com/us/pdp/homedics-portable-sound-spa-machine-with-6-soothing-sounds-timer/1731080462509642695) (~$22–$30) help mask background noises for better sleep.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:11127782019044384256,catalogid:10181924848441947041,gpcid:13356204108310676004,mid:576462774757134093&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:212353570528045725,catalogid:3710191285419376229,gpcid:1267585318501250835,mid:576462483821108911&ibp=oshop)

### Potential Benefits

- **Stress reduction:** Helps lower heart rate, quiet active thoughts, and ease anxiety.
- **Sleep support:** Creates a soothing environment that helps transition the brain into rest.
- **Pain and tension relief:** Physical vibrations can help relax tight muscles and alter pain perception.[[1]](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/urban-survival/201907/the-healing-power-of-sound-as-meditation)[[2]](https://www.uclahealth.org/news/article/what-sound-therapy-and-could-it-benefit-your-health)[[3]](https://www.cedars-sinai.org/stories-and-insights/healthy-living/sound-advice-do-sound-therapy-and-binaural-beats-work)[[4]](https://www.sermo.com/resources/sound-therapy-in-practice/)
